corrections.originalCritique: Strongest feature: The response supplies a principled distinction between logical inconsistency and uneven explanatory naturalness, thereby explaining why localized awkwardness can be weighted by the centrality of the phenomenon whereas contradiction carries a different kind of theoretical liability. Principal limitation: The classification remains contestable because the opponent can treat contradictions as defeasible costs and argue that reflective anomalies disclose foundational explanatory damage rather than merely rough edges. Live burden: The argument must defend both the noncontradictory diagnosis and a principled measure of centrality capable of assigning substantial weight when an exceptional case genuinely transforms understanding. Locked score: The very strong band reflects clear conceptual structure, excellent direct responsiveness, strong burden relevance, and specific comparative support, tempered only by underdefended weights and the continuing possibility that the anomaly's foundational role has been understated.
